_comment: Optional local assets for viz/web/index.html. Set any entry to null/empty to use the built-in procedural cars, sky and road. Paths are relative to this folder. yaw_deg rotates a model so its nose points along +x; models are auto-scaled to 4.5 m length. asphalt.tile_m is the real-world size of one texture tile. Every file listed here must also be listed in LICENSES.md.
